title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2023〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Question! What important event follows Christmas?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The answer is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rin and Len's anniversary☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez... Way to keep us all on the edge of our seats. Isn't that the reason we decided to meet up today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tension makes everything all the more special, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! Now let's get down to business!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We shall be providing Rin and Len with our utmost support as we perform a special show on their anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means that today's going to be a big day for rehearsals! I trust you all will make preparations as necessary!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yessir!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I'd like us to all check our props together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We do have quite a lot of them this time round.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, Rui. Mind if I join you while you check?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
Now, first up is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This ejection device.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey! Isn't that the one from the wedding flash mob?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It holds a special place in our hearts. That makes it the perfect way to mark your anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I remember you said you would save it for when the occasion called for it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes. I'd say now is the perfect time to quite literally “bring out the big gun”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. Looks like everything's in order. Next is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
My turn! I've got 'em!
The glowing bracelets from the night show☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Ah, the night show. Even though we were performing in it that time, it was a night to remember!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for helping us out that time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I remember you guys gave me great advice even before we decided to do the night show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Emu... You don't have to make yourself smile if something is making you feel sad!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whenever something bothers us, it sort of just shows on all of us♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And thanks to that, we're all able to help each other out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So if there is something that's not making you smile, we want to be there to help you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to force yourself to smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna put eeeevery ounce of energy we've got into this to show our gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright! That's good to hear, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, moving on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... There were so many props to check.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. We've ticked everything off the list. That is, everything but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, where's the big showstopper?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah yes, that. I'll need a hand carrying it, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Let's get that sorted now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Would you all mind waiting here?

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Len
rows.Line:
<Okie dokie!>
<No problem.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, Nene! While we're waiting, whaddya say we watch that video from yesterday again?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Video...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Rin and Len in our world are having an anniversary show. She's talking about the teaser for that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here, look.
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hello everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Kagamine Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And Kagamine Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you guys know what makes December 27th so special?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's our anniversary! And what's a better way to celebrate than with an anniversary show?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh!
That Len's also putting on a special show with Rin, huh.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehehe, I can't lose to that, now can I?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really can't wait to help you and Rin put on your show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. After all, with all the attractions in SEKAI involved, it's really going to be a big show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And the storyline is super duper exciting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The flower fairies Len and Rin traverse the land in search of their parents, leaving a trail of blooming flowers in their wake.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And their only lead is a mysterious seed that yields no flowers. With a mystery like that to solve, I had a hard time peeling my eyes from the script.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe, it's actually based on an original story, which we decided to weave a little element of mystique into.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We had some input from KAITO and MEIKO, too. Brainstorming for it was so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The time is nigh for us to showcase the fruits of their labor with a grandiose display!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, I'm putting it down now...
Alright!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's a big bag. What's inside?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's what's going to make this show really “blossom”. See for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! It's those glowing flowers I asked for!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We'll drape them all over the attractions and watch them light up in an array of colors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wowzers! Nene, come check this out! These are like, bigger than our faces!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had a feeling you guys were up to something behind our backs... Wait, aren't these not even props?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What they are matters not, for they are what will illuminate the way to a perfect finale!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that's everything on our preparations checklist covered! Now all that's left is to head to SEKAI for rehearsals!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thank you all so much for going out of your way with all these preparations for me and Rin!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the least we could do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! Celebrating your special day is the perfect way to repay you for all you do for us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not to mention, performing with you guys is sooo much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. So don't hesitate to enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Understood! Let's give it our all during rehearsals!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
